restaurant_name: APEX Surgery Hospital (โรงพยาบาลศัลยกรรมเอเพ็กซ์ เพลินจิต)
text:
Apex Surgery offers everything in one place from a service minded team to a clean, well-maintained facility and highly professional doctors. The clinic has built a strong reputation and feels very trustworthy.

I’m planning to have breast surgery, and this was the first place where I felt truly comfortable discussing my goals and the specific shape I want. The staff took great care of me from the moment I walked in.

What stood out most is that they are not pushy at all. Unlike many places, they really listen to your needs instead of trying to sell you something. P’Yam spent hours with me explaining the procedures in detail, as well as how to prepare before and take care of myself after surgery.

If you’re coming to Thailand for beauty procedures, this is definitely a place worth considering. Special shoutout to P’Yam! & Doctor Jing!

text:
Do NOT engage with this clinic. They are a bunch of thieves who are dishonest, unprofessional and cannot be trusted.

This clinics strategy is to lie and cheat foreigners into paying absurd amounts of money for procedures which I do not believe they are equipped to carry out. From reading previous negative reviews of people who went ahead and paid these prices ended up dissatisfied.

Originally I booked with this clinic at the beginning of the year on the basis of an official quote given at 85,000 baht. I have this in writing in several emails and was agreed and confirmed on with a consultation and even the procedure booked in for December.

Around 4 - 5 months or so later I then emailed again to confirm the dates of consultation and procedure / pricing etc. They emailed back confirming the appointment but then tried to tell me the pricing that was originally agreed on was now something ridiculous like 200,000 baht which is more than double the price and not even a price that one would pay in New Zealand, an expensive country.

After I made it clear to them I was not going to proceed and forwarded the emails of agreed pricing they then come back and explained that there had been a misunderstanding and they had accidentally sent me the wrong pricing for another procedure they would I was also interested in. They confirmed the original agreed price and procedure and said they would honour this.. we gave them the benefit of the doubt and put it down to a miscommunication via email so we then booked our flights for Bangkok.

A day or so before we were supposed to fly out to Bangkok, I emailed them again confirming I would be arriving as planned and discussed timing with them. They emailed me back telling me that they had my details and appointment confirmed but now their promotional pricing had suddenly “ended” and I would now have to pay 180,000 baht.

I immediately cancelled my appointment and consider myself very lucky to have dodged a bullet - thank god I hadn’t paid any deposit or proceeded with them. These people are thieves and cannot be trusted with money let alone the services they provide.

Avoid!

Upon reading their recent positive reviews  they all appear to be “new” accounts, clearly fake.

This clinic should be shut down.

Make  very clear what they have to do and what it cost. Stick with the main branch.
They lose me as a repeat client.

text:
Amazing is a huge understatement for this clinic, I will certainly be back here in the future and would recommend it to friends and family in a heartbeat.
The whole process from start to finish was very professional, I was informed what was going to happen to me at every step of the way by excellent English speaking staff and doctors.
The facility would put most Western clinics to shame and my advice would be that this is the benchmark to aim for should you choose to have any procedure in the future.
Everyone at the clinic was great but I have to say a special thanks to Dr Narupon, he was fantastic and made me feel like a real VIP.
The bandages are off in a week, I can't wait!!

**UPDATE**
The bandages are off and the Otoplasty surgery has been a complete success!!
Even though I had to return to the UK before Dr Narupon could do this personally he has been in contract with me online every step of the way for my "layman's" questions.
The NHS nurse that removed my stitches, here in the UK, said it was perfect stitching which had subsequently healed excellently.
I feel so much better and more confident as a result of this surgery and the real testament is how friends and family don't notice it but when I show them the "before" and "after" pictures they are amazed and impressed, even my hairdresser didn't notice until I said lol.
I appreciate this review is getting a bit long winded and I can guarantee you that I'm not on the Apex payroll, but I really just want to help anyone thinking of surgery make the right choice as I did, everything that I buy I always check reviews first and are influenced by them but never bother to review myself, so here we are 😊
Good luck to you and I hope you make the right decision as I did.
